--- 40 else if
on t(x)
    if x = 0 then
        return "0"
    else if x = 1 then
        return "1"
    else if x = 2 then
        return "2"
    else if x = 3 then
        return "3"
    else if x = 4 then

    else if x = 20 then
        return "20"
    else if x = 21 then

    end if
end t
--- long and chain
on t(x)
    return x ≠ 0 and x ≠ 1 and x ≠ 2 and x ≠ 3 and x ≠ 4 and x ≠ 5 and x ≠ 6 and x ≠ 7 and x ≠ 8 and x ≠ 9 and x ≠ 10 and x ≠ 11 and x ≠ 12 and x ≠ 13 and x ≠ 14 and x ≠ 15 and x ≠ 16 and x ≠ 17 and x ≠ 18 and x ≠ 19 and x ≠ 20 and x ≠ 21 and x ≠ 22 and x ≠ 23 and x ≠ 24 and x ≠ 25 and x ≠ 26 and x ≠ 27 and x ≠ 28 and x ≠ 29

--- 12 nested ifs
on t(x)
    if x > 0 then
        if x > 1 then
            if x > 2 then
                if x > 3 then
                    if x > 4 then
                        if x > 5 then
                            if x > 6 then
                                if x > 7 then
                                    if x > 8 then
                                        if x > 9 then
                                            if x > 10 then
                                                if x > 11 then
                                                    return x
                                                end if
                                            end if
                                        end if
                                    end if
                                end if
                            end if
                        end if
                    end if
                end if
            end if
        end if
    end if
    return 0
end t
--- 6 nested repeats
on t(x)
    set n to 0
    repeat with i0 from 1 to x
        repeat with i1 from 1 to x
            repeat with i2 from 1 to x
                repeat with i3 from 1 to x
                    repeat with i4 from 1 to x
                        repeat with i5 from 1 to x
                            set n to n + 1
                        end repeat
                    end repeat
                end repeat
            end repeat
        end repeat
    end repeat
    return n
end t
--- 8 nested tries
on t(x)
    try
        try
            try
                try
                    try
                        try
                            try
                                try
                                    return x + 1
                                on error e7
                                    return e7
                                end try
                            on error e6
                                return e6
                            end try
                        on error e5
                            return e5
                        end try
                    on error e4
                        return e4
                    end try
                on error e3
                    return e3
                end try
            on error e2
                return e2
            end try
        on error e1
            return e1
        end try
    on error e0
        return e0
    end try
end t

end t

on f(x)
    return x
end f

    return f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(f(x)))))))))))))))))))))))))
end t
